19.    RESOLUTION Amending the Future Land Use Map of PlanCheyenne by changing the
                       —




       land use designation from Agricultural/Rural, Open Space and Parks, and Mixed-Use
       Employment to Community Business and removing the Natural and Cultural Resources
       area designation for property generally located south of Interstate 80, southeast of Otto
       Road. and west of Interstate 25. (POSTPONED FROM SEPTEMBER 28. 2026)

Mr. Esquihel moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. Emmons, Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report and
advised there have been no changes since approval on 2 reading. Public comment was made by
Charles Miller.

21.    RESOLUTION Amending the Future Land Use Map of PlanCheyenne changing the land
                      —




       use designation from Mixed-Use Residential to Mixed-Use Employment for property
       generally located west of South Greeley Highway. south of West College Drive, and
       southwest of and adjacent to the intersection of Apple Street and York Avenue.
       (POSTPONED FROM SEPTEMBER 28, 2026)

Mr Esquibel moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report and
advised there have been no changes since approval on 2’’ reading. Public comment was made by
Charles Miller.

Following the vote on item #21 at 1:08 p.m., Dr. Emmons left the meeting due to a previously
scheduled appointment.

24.    RESOLUTION      —  Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for
       Hitching Post District, City of Cheyenne. Laramie County, Wyoming, located south of
       Interstate 80, southeast of Otto Road, and west of Interstate 25. (SPONSOR      DR.
                                                                                         —




       ALDR IC H)

Dr. Rinne moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Esquihel. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White. Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report and
advised there have been no changes since approval on 2m1 reading. Committee members Esquibel
and Rinne commented on the item and public comment was made by Charles Miller.

27.    RESOLUTION      — Appointing the City of Cheyenne’s representatives to the Wyoming
       Association of Risk Management Joint Powers Board and the Wyoming Association of
       Risk Management Property Insurance Joint Powers Board. (SPONSORS               DR.—




       ALDRICH, DR. RINNE AND MR. WHITE)

Mr. Esquibel moved to adopt. seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.
